title: Fire Safety Risk Assessment
description: Free Fire Safety Risk Assessment template for education you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers fire safety information, fire safety hazard identification and risk assessment, fire safety inspection checklist.
topics: Fire Safety Hazard Identification And Risk Assessment

Fire Safety Inspection Checklist

EXIT ROUTES & DOORS:

☐ All exit paths clear of obstructions (minimum 44" width)

☐ Exit doors unlocked during occupancy

☐ Exit doors open easily (max 15 lbs force)

☐ Exit doors swing in direction of egress

☐ Exit signs illuminated and visible

☐ Emergency lighting functional (tested monthly)

☐ Path markings clear and visible

☐ Stairways clear and well-lit

☐ Handrails secure

☐ No storage in corridors (including temporary)

☐ Exit routes lead directly to outside/safe area

FIRE ALARM SYSTEM:

☐ Fire alarm control panel functional (no trouble signals)

☐ Pull stations accessible and unobstructed

☐ Pull stations visible and labeled

☐ Smoke detectors operational (tested)

☐ Heat detectors operational (tested)

☐ Horns/strokes audible and visible (tested)

☐ System monitored by central station

☐ Annual professional inspection complete

☐ Weekly testing log maintained

☐ Batteries tested/replaced per schedule

☐ System upgrades as required

☐ Extinguishers mounted (not on floor)

☐ Height appropriate (max 5' to handle)

☐ Access clear (no obstructions)

☐ Monthly visual check documented

☐ Annual professional inspection current

☐ Hydrostatic testing current (if applicable)

☐ Staff trained in proper use (PASS method)

FIRE SPRINKLER SYSTEM:

☐ Sprinkler heads unobstructed (no storage within 18")

☐ No paint on sprinkler heads

☐ Control valves open and locked/sealed

☐ Water flow tested annually

☐ System inspected by certified professional

☐ Winterized if applicable

☐ No leaks or corrosion visible

ELECTRICAL SAFETY:

☐ Electrical panels accessible (30" clear space)

☐ Panels labeled correctly

☐ No extension cords used as permanent wiring

☐ Cords not run under rugs or through walls

☐ All cords in good condition (no fraying)

☐ Outlets not overloaded (power strips with breakers)

☐ GFCI outlets in wet locations (kitchens, bathrooms)

☐ No daisy-chaining of power strips

☐ Electrical room clear of storage

☐ Annual infrared thermography completed (if applicable)

FLAMMABLE MATERIALS STORAGE:

☐ Flammable liquids in approved containers/cabinets

☐ Flammable cabinet self-closing and labeled

☐ Limited quantities outside cabinet (≤10 gallons)

☐ No flammable materials near ignition sources

☐ Oily rags in metal containers with lids

☐ Aerosol cans stored away from heat

☐ Chemical storage area well-ventilated

☐ Waste materials disposed of properly

HOUSEKEEPING:

☐ No excessive combustible materials (paper, cardboard)

☐ Recycling/trash removed regularly

☐ Storage rooms organized and clean

☐ Attic/crawl spaces free of combustibles

☐ No smoking policy enforced

☐ Decorations flame-retardant (if used)

☐ Decorative materials not blocking exits

☐ Holiday decorations removed after events

KITCHEN/FOOD SERVICE:

☐ Hood suppression system inspected (semi-annually)

☐ Hood cleaning up to date (per schedule)

☐ Class K extinguisher available and inspected

☐ No grease buildup on surfaces

☐ Appliances maintained and clean

☐ Automatic shut-offs functional

☐ Staff trained in kitchen fire procedures

☐ Emergency shut-off switches accessible

SPECIAL HAZARD AREAS:

☐ Boiler room clear of combustibles

☐ Mechanical rooms locked/secure

☐ Lab fire safety equipment appropriate

☐ Computer/server room fire suppression adequate

☐ Art room flammable materials stored properly

☐ Shop areas (wood/metal) have appropriate extinguishers

☐ Dust collection systems clean and functional

EVACUATION PLAN:

☐ Written evacuation plan posted in all rooms

☐ Maps show "You Are Here" and primary/secondary routes

☐ Assembly areas designated and communicated

☐ Accountability procedure established

☐ Staff assigned specific emergency duties

☐ Special needs evacuation plan developed

☐ Evacuation drills conducted monthly

☐ Drill times and results documented

☐ Drill critiques conducted

☐ Plan reviewed/updated annually
